name: context-menu
useFor: Use for the actions on a thing people point at directly (a parcel on the map or in a list), as a shortcut to actions that are also reachable another way. A long menu fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: The only way to reach an action
Rounded corners or a shadow on the panel
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the dropdown menu's panel and rows

title: Context Menu
description: The dropdown menu's panel on right-click or long-press: a Bone frame with the 6px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, square 32px rows with Fog under the highlight, Mist while pressed, and Mireye's check on a chosen row.
